newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TENNIS-COETZER FIRST SEED TO FALL AT EUROPEAN INDOOR.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-COETZER FIRST SEED TO FALL AT EUROPEAN INDOOR.

text.p: Eighth seed Amanda Coetzer of South Africa became the first seed to crash out of the European indoor tennis championships when she lost 2-6 7-6 6-4 to Russian wild card Anna Kournikova on Monday.
Sixth seed Brenda Schultz-McCarthy of the Netherlands and seventh seed Magdalena Maleeva of Bulgaria both survived the opening round.
Schultz-McCarthy, ranked 11th in the world, needed three sets to beat German qualifier Petra Begerow 6-3 4-6 6-4 while Maleeva disposed of Miriam Oremans of the Netherlands 6-3 7-5.
The top four seeds, including number one Conchita Martinez of Spain, all received first round byes.
